meta.title: 高难度压纹郁金香
meta.topic: 咖啡拉花 · 高难度郁金香

scenes.title_en: Open the Base With a Stream
scenes.context: 引流开底，原地摆动形成基础层。先用小流量在底部做基础层，为郁金香打底。语域：咖啡教学，步骤讲解。
sentences: Open the base with a stream, swinging in place.
A solid base makes the flower easy to draw.
paraphrase: 引流开底 → open the base / start with a stream
open the base · start with a stream
基础层 → the foundation layer / the base
scenes.speak: Open the base with a stream, swinging in place. Build the foundation layer first. A solid base makes the flower easy to draw.

scenes.context: 加大流量，让纹路清晰浮现。流量加大后，底层纹路被推开、清晰显示出来。语域：咖啡教学，步骤讲解。
sentences: 加大流量，纹路清晰浮现。
Increase the flow so the lines show clearly.
With the right flow, the lines become distinct.
这一步决定纹路的清晰度。
This step decides how crisp the lines are.
paraphrase: 加大流量 → increase the flow / pour harder
清晰浮现 → show clearly / come into focus
scenes.speak: Increase the flow so the lines show clearly. With the right flow, the lines become distinct. This step decides how crisp the lines are.

scenes.context: 回包动作包裹纹路，形成郁金香轮廓。用回包把纹路裹起来，画出郁金香的花瓣轮廓。语域：咖啡教学，步骤讲解。
sentences: The wrap-back move encloses the lines.
纹路被裹起来，形成轮廓。
The lines get wrapped into a silhouette.
郁金香的形状，就出来了。
paraphrase: 回包 → wrap back / fold around
scenes.speak: The wrap-back move encloses the lines. The lines get wrapped into a silhouette. And the tulip shape emerges.

scenes.context: 顶部点一个点，为郁金香画龙点睛。最后在花顶部点一个点收尾，图案更完整。语域：咖啡教学，收尾。
sentences: 顶部点一个点，画龙点睛。
Finish with a dot on top — the final touch.
One dot completes the whole pattern.
高难度郁金香，就完成了。
And the advanced tulip is done.
the advanced tulip（高难度郁金香）
paraphrase: 画龙点睛 → the final touch / the finishing dot
scenes.speak: Finish with a dot on top — the final touch. One dot completes the whole pattern. And the advanced tulip is done.
